Class Theme

java.lang.Object
stockly.ui.Theme
public final class Theme extends Object
Central design tokens for the Stockly interface.

Every color, font and spacing value used across the application is defined here so the visual identity stays consistent and can be retuned in one place.

Author:
Tooba Akram invalid input: '&' Abeeha Noor
